ns2:course.label: Microcomputer Laboratory
ns2:course.description: Design, construction, and use of a small general-purpose computer with a micro-processor CPU; MSI and LSI circuits used extensively; control panel, peripheral controllers, control logic, central processor, and programming experiments. Open lab format. Prerequisite: ECE 385; ECE 391 or CS 232. Recommended: Credit or concurrent registration in ECE 411.
